name: light_sensor
summary: An ambient-light phototransistor (ALS-PT19) with its load resistor and filter capacitor, to an ADC input
note: The phototransistor's collector is on VDD and its emitter drives OUT, loaded by R_LOAD and filtered by C_FILT. The output is the photocurrent times R_LOAD, until it saturates near VDD: a larger load reads dimmer light and saturates sooner. The bolt earring uses 22 kohm, from simple_earring rev 2 (vendored with the bolt earring: boards/bolt-earring/vendor/simple_earring/scripts/circuit.py): about 0.33 V at 100 lux, saturating near 900 lux. Mount it facing out, away from LEDs it would read.

Q1.note: 1 collector, 2 emitter. The footprint is simple_earring's (library parts.pretty, vendored with the bolt earring)

citations.figure: Package Dimensions: top and bottom views with terminal 1 (bottom view 'Collector Mark') and terminal 2, the phototransistor symbol labelled 1 Collector, 2 Emitter, and the recommended soldering pads (0.8 x 0.8 mm at 1.5 mm pitch).
citations.note: Device:Q_Photo_NPN is C 1, E 2; simple_earring's SENSOR_ALS-PT19 footprint has 0.8 mm square pads 1 and 2 at 1.5 mm pitch.

citations.figure: Converting Photocurrent to Voltage: Vcc on the collector, the emitter (Iph) to Vout, loaded by RL and CL to GND.

citations.quote: The output voltage (Vout) is the product of photocurrent (IPH) and loading resistor (RL)

citations.note: Units not given; read as kohm x uF, 22 kohm x 100 nF is 2.2.
Light current min / typ at 100 lux (white fluorescent): 15 uA x 22 kohm is the note's 0.33 V, typical; the minimum gives 0.11 V.
Typ 150 uA at 1000 lux: with VDD 3.3 V the 22 kohm load saturates at (3.3 - 0.4) V / 22 kohm = 132 uA, near 900 lux typical.
